weeks.title: Ancient & Classical World: Historical/geographic inquiry
weeks.instructor_overview: Introduce and develop historical/geographic inquiry within the context of Ancient & Classical World. Use explicit instruction, worked examples or models, guided practice, and independent application.
learning_objectives: Describe the major concepts and evidence associated with historical/geographic inquiry.
Analyze relationships among people, institutions, events, or places.
Support conclusions using relevant evidence and context.
